website.summary: Pipeline lists Actimab-A, ATNM-400, Iomab-B, Iomab-ACT

indications.indication: Targeted conditioning for allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant in relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized, controlled trial of Iomab-B vs conventional care in older subjects with active R/R AML; met primary endpoint of durable complete remission (dCR); secondary OS endpoint not met due to high cross-over from control to Iomab-B arm
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (Phase 3 SIERRA — enrollment complete; FDA alignment received on follow-on Phase 2/3 trial design in expanded R/R AML population age 18+)
key_milestones: FDA alignment on follow-on Phase 2/3 trial design in expanded age 18+ R/R AML population (NCT07157514, planned start January 2026 — Not Yet Recruiting)
Actively seeking strategic partner to advance through pivotal development

pipeline.modality: CD45-targeted radioimmunotherapy used as targeted lymphodepletion / conditioning

indications.indication: Conditioning prior to commercial CD19 CAR-T therapy in relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma (specifically DLBCL)
indications.trial_name: IOMAB-CAR-T followed by CAR-T in R/R DLBCL
indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 evaluating Iomab-ACT/Iomab-B as conditioning prior to commercial CD19 CAR-T cell therapy in R/R DLBCL/NHL; primary endpoint engraftment; secondary endpoints CRS and ICANS incidence
indications.lead_sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center (Actinium collaborator; Actinium-supplied asset, listed by 10-K as company clinical trial)

indications.indication: Conditioning prior to experimental CD19 CAR-T cell therapy in relapsed/refractory B-cell malignancies (NHL, ALL/lymphoma)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 evaluating Iomab-ACT as conditioning prior to CD19 CAR-T in R/R B-cell malignancies

indications.indication: Conditioning for allogeneic bone marrow transplant in advanced sickle cell disease
indications.trial_name: 131I-apamistamab-based conditioning for HSCT in advanced SCD
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 evaluating 131I-apamistamab as conditioning for allogeneic HSCT in patients with advanced sickle cell disease
indications.lead_sponsor: Columbia University (Actinium collaborator; Actinium-supplied asset, listed by 10-K as company-sponsored clinical trial in non-malignant hematologic disease)

pipeline.modality: CD33-targeted alpha-emitter radioimmunotherapy (Ac-225 conjugated humanized anti-CD33 mAb)

indications.indication: Relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML) — backbone therapy in combination with CLAG-M chemotherapy
indications.trial_name: Actimab-A + CLAG-M Phase 1b (completed) and planned Phase 2/3
indications.trial_design: Completed Phase 1b in R/R AML (high-risk including TP53-mutated, prior venetoclax failure) with high MRD-negative CR rates and 24-month median OS in transplant-eligible subgroup; FDA alignment received on Phase 2/3 trial design in first or second salvage R/R AML
indications.trial_status: Phase 1b completed (Leukemia, Feb 2025); FDA alignment on Phase 2/3 design — actively seeking strategic partner to execute
key_milestones: Phase 1b results published in Leukemia, February 2025

indications.indication: Frontline AML (triplet combination with venetoclax + hypomethylating agent) and high-risk MDS — NCI CRADA programs
indications.trial_name: Actimab-A NCI CRADA programs (frontline AML triplet, high-risk MDS monotherapy, FLT3/IDH/menin combinations, maintenance)
indications.trial_design: Multiple Actimab-A clinical programs in collaboration with NCI under CRADA exploring frontline AML triplet, high-risk MDS post-HMA, combinations with FLT3/IDH/menin inhibitors, and maintenance therapy
indications.lead_sponsor: Actinium Pharmaceuticals (with National Cancer Institute under CRADA)

excluded_preclinical: ATNM-400 (first-in-class Ac-225 antibody radioconjugate to undisclosed pan-tumor target) — preclinical/IND-enabling for mCRPC, EGFR-mutant NSCLC, HER2-resistant and tamoxifen-resistant breast cancer
Actimab-A for solid-tumor MDSC depletion (combination with pembrolizumab/nivolumab in HNSCC, NSCLC, GBM, MSI-H CRC) — Phase 1b basket trial planned, not yet initiated
excluded_legacy_terminated: Lintuzumab-Ac225 + Venetoclax + Azacitidine R/R AML Phase 1/2 (NCT03932318) — withdrawn
Lintuzumab-Ac225 in refractory multiple myeloma Phase 1 (NCT02998047) — terminated
Lintuzumab-Ac225 + Venetoclax R/R AML Phase 1/2 (NCT03867682) — status unknown (last updated stale)
Lintuzumab-Ac225 in older AML Phase 1/2 (NCT02575963) — completed

summary_counts.note: Counts are per asset-indication pair retained in pipeline (Iomab-B P3 R/R AML; Iomab-ACT P2 commercial CAR-T conditioning; Actimab-A P2 R/R AML CLAG-M; plus three P1 indication tracks)
